text: BAM share rose 0.3 percentage points over the last 23 hours and 0.09 percentage points over 7 days, to 34.4% of all Solana stake. Concentration remains elevated: ams-mainnet-bam-1-tee holds 22.1% of BAM stake, and the node Nakamoto coefficient is 3. The 65 top-node leadership changes in this window should be read as whale-driven routing, not a structural rollover.
